items.title: The Preterm Brain Is Also What It Eats: A Systematic Review of Nutrition and Neuroimaging Outcomes in Preterm Infants

ai.headline: Early nutrition in preterm babies is linked to some favorable brain measures on scans, but evidence is weak.

ai.why_it_matters: It shows that what preterm babies eat may be linked to early brain development, but the evidence is too weak to draw firm conclusions for everyday feeding decisions.
